sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 native model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact page and embedded model object independently fetched. The grok-build-0.1 object specifies 256,000 context, TEXT/IMAGE inputs, TEXT output and true functionCalling, structuredOutputs and reasoning flags. The current legacy Code Fast aliases are routing identities, not evidence of unchanged original weights.

sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 on API, May 29, 2026
sources.evidence: Dated primary announcement explicitly opens the exact model in public API beta, describes training for agentic coding and says it powers Grok Build. No parameter count or neural architecture is supplied.

sources.title: Release notes: Grok Build beta and Build 0.1 early access
sources.evidence: Fresh HTML independently fetched: May 14 announces the Grok Build harness beta; May 19 names the exact grok-build-0.1 model and early access. These are earlier milestones than the May 29 public API beta. No April 16 model release entry appears.

sources.title: May 15, 2026 Model Retirement
sources.evidence: Current official migration guide, last updated September 2, explicitly says requests to retired grok-code-fast-1 are routed to grok-build-0.1 after May 15. This is earlier than the May 19 early-access entry and does not establish an exact first release day. It distinguishes replacement from unchanged weights.

sources.title: Chat with Files
sources.evidence: Attached files automatically activate document-search tools and an agentic workflow. PDF attachment support is not an additional native model modality.

sources.title: Enterprise terms, May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Release-period terms grant limited hosted service access. Section 4 reserves the underlying technology and intellectual property to xAI or suppliers; no weight redistribution license is granted.

sources.title: xai-org public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: Fresh official-organization inventory contains Grok-1 and Grok-2, not Grok Build 0.1. Corroborates hosted distribution alongside the model announcement and terms, rather than proving a universal negative alone.

sources.title: Grok Build is Now Open Source, July 15, 2026
sources.evidence: Primary release expressly publishes the agent harness: context assembly, tool dispatch, terminal UI and extensions. It supports local inference configuration, but does not publish the Grok Build 0.1 model weights.

sources.title: Safety and model-card index
sources.evidence: Current primary index provides Grok 4.5/4.6/4.7 and earlier Grok cards but no exact Grok Build 0.1 card. No exact-model technical report was obtained.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 model card, revision July 20, 2026
sources.evidence: Independently searched cached complete 29-page original PDF text for exact Build 0.1 names, counts and architecture, and inspected Grok Build mentions. It refers to the harness and its newer Grok 4.5 default, not Build 0.1 network specifications. No exact Build 0.1 counts or layout found.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 model card, revision August 17, 2026
sources.evidence: Independently searched cached complete 42-page original PDF text and inspected Grok Build references. They describe the harness or Grok 4.6 distribution/evaluation. Its 1.5T family statement names Grok 4.6, not Build 0.1, so it is not transferred.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 model card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Independently searched cached complete 30-page original PDF text and inspected Grok Build references. These describe the harness and newer model default, not Build 0.1. No assigned-model total/active count or topology disclosure found.

sources.title: Imported Models.dev entry
sources.evidence: Upstream supplies April 16 and PDF modality but no primary support for the date. Used only to identify the imported assertions being corrected.

sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 provider documentation
sources.evidence: Provider documents 256K, text/image input, reasoning and tools, with a May 20 provider release date. That listing date is distinguished from native early access and public beta milestones.

sources.title: Third-party reporting of an unattributed size claim
sources.evidence: Search-indexed article mentions a third-party 309B/15B MoE claim but explicitly says it is unattributed and unconfirmed by xAI. It is a rejected research lead, not evidence for those specifications. Targeted developer/founder/researcher and exact-model training/interpretability searches produced no primary confirmation.

name.note: Exact native API model name; distinguish it from the Grok Build application.

developer.note: Original xAI developer attribution; current SpaceXSI branding does not turn it into a different developer record.

family.note: Retain the normalized Grok Build model-line label; this is catalog grouping, not a claim about shared neural architecture.

release_date.note: May is supported, but the exact first public day is unresolved: May 14 harness beta, routing after May 15, May 19 exact-model early access, May 20 provider listing and May 29 public API beta. The April 16 import has no verified release evidence. Month precision avoids selecting one rollout milestone as an unsupported first day.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary model. July open-source harness code does not release its weights; no Build 0.1 checkpoint found in the official public distribution inventory.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification under release-period terms. Do not transfer the harness source-code license to the model.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter disclosure found for exact Build 0.1 in accessed primary sources or exact-model developer/founder searches. Unattributed third-party 309B is not adopted; newer Grok defaults and preceding Code Fast routing identities do not establish this model size.

active_parameters_b.note: No active-per-token disclosure found for the assigned model. Unattributed 15B claim is not verified; no inference from total size, throughput or later defaults.

architecture.note: No primary neural-network architecture disclosure found after exact-model training/interpretability research and later-card checks. Agent harness architecture and internal API algorithm labels are not neural topology. The unattested MoE/hybrid-attention claim is not adopted.

context_window.note: Exact native model object and page agree on 256,000 tokens. The commercial 200K long-context pricing threshold is not the maximum context.

modalities.note: Native modalities from the exact model payload. Remove PDF because file attachment processing uses document-search tools.

reasoning.note: Exact native feature flag is true; this does not assert an adjustable effort setting or availability of visible internal reasoning.

tool_call.note: Exact functionCalling flag and original announcement support function/tool calling.

description.value: Coding model trained for agentic software engineering, with text and image input, reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Neutral documented purpose and capabilities; remove unqualified speed framing.

sources.label: Release notes: Grok Build beta and Build 0.1 early access
Grok Build is Now Open Source, July 15, 2026

patch.notes: Released in May 2026; the exact first public day is unresolved. Native sources distinguish the May 14 Grok Build harness beta, routing from retired Code Fast after May 15, May 19 Build 0.1 early access, and May 29 public API beta. Parameters, active count and neural architecture are not disclosed in the primary sources reviewed. Grok Build application source code is separate from this hosted model. Legacy Code Fast aliases are compatibility redirects. Native inputs are text and images; PDF attachments use document-search tools.

summary: Correct the unsupported April release to May 2026 with month precision and explicit rollout milestones; remove native PDF modality, add proprietary classification and neutral description. Confirm 256K context, reasoning and tools. Exact-model total/active counts and neural architecture remain undisclosed after primary-source, founder/researcher, later-card and training-research checks. Keep the model separate from its open-source agent harness and legacy compatibility aliases.
